label: Take part
heading: Where is it, and what is it like?
intro: Pain has no number that fits it. This is built on **body mapping** — mark where a sensation sits, then choose the image nearest to what it feels like. You compose a sentence; nothing here is stored.
choose_label: Choose the one nearest to it
disclaimer: A communication aid, not a diagnosis. If pain is affecting you, speak to a clinician.

choices.title: That Sinking Feeling
choices.science: Anxiety and depression often travel with chronic pain; the encoding regions interact.

choices.title: Chronic
choices.science: When pain outlasts its cause it becomes pathological — and hard to treat.

choices.title: Fleur du Mal
choices.science: The poppy, Papaver somniferum, and the body’s own opioids sit behind this bloom.

choices.title: In Blue
choices.science: Relieving pain often does not relieve the anxiety bound up with it.

choices.title: Rewiring
choices.science: Cutaneous receptors and their nerves carry both touch and its disruption.
